evidence.quote: Most Dwarf words have several meanings.
evidence.claim: Context determines the selected sense. We select ordinary written books, alphabetic runes and a writing tool, not magical power or a specific recorded history.
The glossary prints Klinkarun; the prose on p43 prints Klinkarhun for the alphabet. This pack preserves the glossary spelling without inventing a dialect rule.
The 8th-edition army book corroborates ordinary writing as distinct from the magical rune rules beside it. Its spelling is Klinkarhun; this does not turn the library into a Runesmith workshop.

The passage directly grounds writing-material imagery and describes books on thin metal scrolls, including gold or copper. Material-book and material-alphabetic-rune motifs are compositions; they do not populate the library with objects or determine their materials.

Dwarf book storage is explicitly associated with underground vaults. Using a hall or vault as a library emblem is an adaptation that does not grant temple affiliation, clan books, historical importance, holdings, or actual room geometry.

Agrul supplies the stone-carving sense, selected in the writing-on-stone context of p43; Azul and Duraz supply metal and stone. No wrinkles, venerable age, reliability, or historical content are implied.

Irkul retains this complete meaning and Khaz means an underground hall. Compounds juxtapose a book or ordinary alphabetic-writing image with an architectural emblem; no general Khazalid grammar or actual building is inferred.
The specific material sense is retained in full. It does not imply that a generated library or any book is ancient, nor that any actual oakwood object is present.
Silver and bread are attested independent concepts, not invented product or wealth claims.
The selected moonlight sense and the printed material, shadow, work and sunrise nouns add distinct concepts. No generic machine, dawn-direction, geology or ancestry meaning is invented.

The conjunction explicitly pairs two reviewed images. Thrag means wound, Thrynaz includes laws, Tiwaz includes rest and Skaud includes song. These are not new translations for hospital, government or tavern.

High-resolution printed text confirms Zunthrum with n. Spear, money, sunset, remembering and gift are independently attested; none assigns actual stock, wealth, a historical event or a commemorated person.
